en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Ziyad b. al-Ja`far al-Hamadani (ra) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father Ibrahim b. Hashim from `Abdullah b. al-Mughira from Isma`il b. Muslim from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers from `Ali (as). He said:
The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Surely, a servant will be imprisoned for a sin from his sins for one hundred years while looking at his wives and brothers in Paradise.
